missionsCreate.title: Request transport
missionsCreate.intro: Use when a lot is ready to leave the farm.
missionsCreate.workflowStep1: 1) Report harvest — the team sees your plan (dates, channel, expected quantity).
missionsCreate.workflowStep2: 2) They confirm what to prepare and coordinate with you (admin "Harvest plans" + notes to you in process).
missionsCreate.workflowStep3: 3) When the lot is packed (PACKED / quality done), enter pickup here. Operations sets the delivery route in the admin panel — you do not see the buyer destination.
missionsCreate.multiFarmTitle: Two farms, one buyer order (e.g. 800 kg + 200 kg)
missionsCreate.multiFarmBody: One trip = one batch. Each grower sends their own request for their lot. Operations links related runs and assigns logistics; you do not enter the final delivery address.
missionsCreate.opsRouteBoxBody: You only share farm pickup details here. BioVera operations assigns the carrier and enters the full drop-off for drivers.

missionsCreate.locationHintDenied: Allow location or enter GPS manually.

missionsCreate.whereItGoes: Where it goes (logistics and drivers need this). Use the same city name on each run you want to combine on one truck.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceBodyShort: Packing photos and label roll for this batch.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceWhy: "Quality confirmed" here means your quality entry for the batch is done — it is separate from packing proof for transport. To request a truck the server also requires the three Bio Vera packing photos plus one verified label roll tied to this batch (material-control rule).
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceMissingSticker: No label roll has been recorded for this batch yet.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceUnchecked: Packing status not verified — open compliance if send fails.
missionsCreate.packagingIncompleteBody: This batch is missing packing proof (photos and/or label roll). Use "Open packing compliance" or Profile → Packing compliance.

The server database is missing an update — migrations probably were not applied (this is usually not caused by wrong data you typed on this screen).

buyerOrderActions.stale: Previously loaded information is shown. Refresh before taking another action.
buyerOrderActions.noMatches: No orders match this filter and search.

hints.paymentPending: The payment record is being processed. Wait for a status update; do not send the same payment again.
hints.preparing: Payment is recorded. Operations is preparing the goods and arranging delivery; the linked delivery will appear here.
hints.closed: This order is closed. Its details and existing records remain available.
hints.report: Receipt has been recorded. If something is wrong with the shipment, open the delivery and submit a report with photos.
hints.evidence: Review the recorded receipt, evidence and decisions on reports.
hints.receipt: This delivery is marked as delivered. Review the handover and confirm receipt once you physically receive the goods.
hints.track: Open the linked delivery for its current status and handover.
hints.payment: Your order is approved and goods are reserved. Bank details and the payment reference are in the order.
hints.approval: Goods are reserved. Operations is reviewing the request.
hints.allocation: Operations must allocate specific stock before further approval and payment.
hints.details: Preparation and further updates are available in the order details.

buyerReceiving.title: Receiving code
buyerReceiving.hint: When the truck arrives, show this code to the driver — they scan it to start the handover. Then you check the goods and sign.
